action_items: IMPORTANT: The <script src='/api/pulsedesk/widget.js'...> tag in public/index.html was NOT being served until I restarted the frontend supervisor process. CRA/craco does not hot-reload changes to public/index.html — it caches the served HTML in memory. When main-agent edits public/index.html in the future, they MUST run `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` for the change to reach visitors. This is a one-time action needed only when public/index.html is touched.
Consider repositioning the launch-offer promo banner (or the chat bubble) so they do not overlap in the bottom-right corner. Both currently occupy bottom:24px, right:24px.
critical_code_review_comments: pulsedesk_router.py L131 — `visitor_message` handler mutates `visitor_meta={'url': request.headers.get('referer','')}` on every call. If the visitor previously registered richer visitor_meta on /visitor/join it will be overwritten to `{url:...}` on the next /visitor/message. Consider merging instead of replacing, or only setting visitor_meta on first-time conversation creation.

widget.js L14 — `document.currentScript` is null when the script is loaded async and executed after DOMContentLoaded on some browsers (especially when injected dynamically). Consider hardening by falling back to `document.querySelector('[data-testid="pulsedesk-loader"]')` if `currentScript` is null.

Widget script uses `async` attribute in index.html — this is fine for the current CRA-served HTML (no dynamic re-injection on client navigation), but worth documenting because SPA route changes will NOT re-run the widget script (this is correct — the widget is idempotent by design, injected once on first HTML load).

rca of the issue: Initial testing found the widget bubble was missing from ALL routes. Root cause: CRA/craco's development server caches public/index.html contents in memory when it starts — subsequent edits to that file (like the <script src='/api/pulsedesk/widget.js'> tag main-agent added) are NOT hot-reloaded. Verified by curl of the root URL which returned HTML without the script tag. Mitigation: ran `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`; after restart the served HTML contained the script tag, the widget injected on every route, and all 10 UI flows passed. Main-agent's earlier verification succeeded because they had freshly restarted frontend after their edit; the state was lost by the time the testing agent arrived (likely due to an unrelated hot-reload of App.js which does not re-read public/index.html).
